abilities.Adaptability: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.
abilities.Aftermath: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
abilities.Air Lock: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
abilities.Anger Point: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.
abilities.Anticipation: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
abilities.Arena Trap: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.
abilities.Bad Dreams: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.
abilities.Blaze: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.Clear Body: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.Cloud Nine: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
abilities.Color Change: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden.
abilities.Cute Charm: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.Damp: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
abilities.Download: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.
abilities.Drizzle: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.Drought: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.Dry Skin: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.Early Bird: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
abilities.Effect Spore: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.Filter: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
abilities.Flame Body: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.Flash Fire: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
abilities.Flower Gift: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.
abilities.Forecast: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.
abilities.Forewarn: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
abilities.Frisk: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
abilities.Gluttony: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
abilities.Guts: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
abilities.Heatproof: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.
abilities.Honey Gather: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.
abilities.Hustle: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.
abilities.Hydration: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
abilities.Hyper Cutter: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.Ice Body: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.
abilities.Intimidate: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
abilities.Iron Fist: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.
abilities.Klutz: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative.
abilities.Leaf Guard: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments.
abilities.Lightning Rod: If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself.
abilities.Liquid Ooze: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.
abilities.Magic Guard: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move.
abilities.Magnet Pull: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.
abilities.Marvel Scale: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
abilities.Minus: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus.
abilities.Mold Breaker: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
abilities.Motor Drive: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.
abilities.Multitype: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.
abilities.Natural Cure: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
abilities.No Guard: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
abilities.Normalize: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.
abilities.Oblivious: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.
abilities.Overgrow: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.Pickup: After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one.
abilities.Plus: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Minus.
abilities.Poison Heal: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.
abilities.Poison Point: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.Pressure: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
abilities.Quick Feet: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
abilities.Rain Dish: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.
abilities.Reckless: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
abilities.Rivalry: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.
abilities.Rough Skin: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
abilities.Run Away: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
abilities.Sand Stream: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.Sand Veil: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.Scrappy: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.
abilities.Serene Grace: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.
abilities.Shadow Tag: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
abilities.Shed Skin: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 30% of being cured of any major status ailment.
abilities.Shield Dust: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.Simple: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.
abilities.Skill Link: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear.
abilities.Slow Start: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
abilities.Sniper: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
abilities.Snow Cloak: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.
abilities.Snow Warning: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.Solar Power: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
abilities.Solid Rock: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
abilities.Soundproof: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Prevents Heal Bell from curing the Pokémon, whether or not it is in battle.
abilities.Speed Boost: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
abilities.Stall: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.
abilities.Static: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.Steadfast: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.
abilities.Sticky Hold: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
abilities.Storm Drain: If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself.
abilities.Sturdy: One Hit KO moves have no effect when used on this Pokemon.
abilities.Suction Cups: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.
abilities.Super Luck: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
abilities.Swarm: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.Synchronize: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment.
abilities.Technician: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less.
abilities.Thick Fat: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
abilities.Tinted Lens: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
abilities.Torrent: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.Trace: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Forecast, Multitype, or Trace.
abilities.Unaware: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
abilities.Unburden: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
abilities.Volt Absorb: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.Water Absorb: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.White Smoke: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.Wonder Guard: This Pokemon is only damaged by Fire Fang, supereffective moves, indirect damage.
